name: what-if-crts-won-2026
description: FICTION: 'Sony GDM-UX910' (2026) — the counterfactual timeline where CRT R&D never stopped. Magnetically-damped 1800-triad grille (no damper wires), 1200-line raster at razor spot size, rolling scan native, vestigial bloom on peak whites because electron guns still obey physics. A plausible extrapolation, not a real product — every real preset in this bank cites hardware; this one cites a dream.
